$comment: ARD table (leaf) descriptors sampled from the live registry (registry/meta.json), excluding BigQuery-backed tables. Each table is one queryable measure/entry within a source; access and capability are inherited from its source _access.md.

tables.title: Accelerated Share Repurchase Program, Adjustment — SEC EDGAR
tables.description: The amount needed to adjust previously recorded stockholders' equity balances to the actual aggregate amounts paid, whether in cash or other consideration, to acquire all of the shares purchased under an Accelerated Share Repurchase arrangement.
representativeQueries: What is the adjustment for stockholders' equity in an accelerated share repurchase program?
How do you calculate the adjustment for an accelerated share repurchase?
What amount is needed to adjust equity for accelerated share repurchases?
Can you explain the adjustment for shares purchased in an accelerated share repurchase?

tables.title: Assets Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Carrying Amount — SEC EDGAR
tables.description: Carrying amount of assets sold under agreements to repurchase when the carrying amount (or market value, if higher than the carrying amount) of securities or other assets sold under repurchase agreements exceeds 10 percent of total assets.
representativeQueries: What is the carrying amount of assets sold under repurchase agreements?
Can you provide the carrying value of repurchase agreement assets?
How much are the assets sold under repurchase agreements worth?
What is the carrying amount for the repurchase agreement assets?

tables.title: Cash Surrender Value of Life Insurance — SEC EDGAR
tables.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts which could be received based on the terms of the insurance contract upon surrendering life policies owned by the entity.
representativeQueries: What is the cash surrender value of life insurance policies?
How much cash can we receive upon surrendering life insurance?
Can you tell me the total cash amount for life insurance surrender value?

tables.title: Crypto Asset, Number of Units, Restricted — SEC EDGAR
tables.description: Number of crypto asset units held subject to contractual sale restriction. Excludes crypto asset units held for platform user.
representativeQueries: What is the number of restricted crypto asset units we hold?
Can you tell me how many crypto asset units are under sale restrictions?
How many units of crypto assets are restricted from sale?

tables.title: Deferred Compensation Share-Based Arrangements, Liability, Classified, Noncurrent — SEC EDGAR
tables.description: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for stock option plans and other equity-based compensation arrangements payable after one year (or the operating cycle, if longer).
representativeQueries: What is the noncurrent liability for deferred compensation share-based arrangements?
Can you show me the carrying value of liabilities for stock option plans payable after one year?
How much is the liability for deferred compensation arrangements classified as noncurrent?
What is the total noncurrent liability for share-based compensation arrangements?

tables.title: Deposit Liabilities, Effect of Change in Present Value Assumptions Recorded as Expense — SEC EDGAR
tables.description: Amount of expense due to change in the present value assumptions on expected recoveries.
representativeQueries: What is the expense related to changes in present value assumptions for deposit liabilities?

How much expense was recorded due to changes in present value assumptions?

tables.title: Dividends Receivable — SEC EDGAR
tables.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of dividends declared but not received.
representativeQueries: What are the dividends receivable on the balance sheet?
Can you show me the amount of declared dividends that we haven't received?
How much do we have in dividends that are due to us?

tables.title: Long-Term Federal Home Loan Bank Advances, Current — SEC EDGAR
tables.description: The current portion of Federal Home Loan Bank borrowings initially due beyond one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.
representativeQueries: What is the current portion of our long-term Federal Home Loan Bank advances?

tables.title: Financing Receivable, Year Five, Originated, Four Years before Current Fiscal Year, Writeoff — SEC EDGAR
tables.description: Amount of writeoff of financing receivable originated four years before current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

tables.title: Incentive Distribution, Distribution — SEC EDGAR

tables.title: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Written Put Options — SEC EDGAR
tables.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of outstanding written put options using the reverse treasury stock method.

tables.title: Investment Company, Tax Basis, Capital Loss Carryforward (Utilization) — SEC EDGAR

tables.title: Property, Plant, and Equipment, before Accumulated Depreciation, Period Increase (Decrease) — SEC EDGAR
tables.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

tables.title: Restricted Investments — SEC EDGAR
tables.description: Investments which are not defined as or included in marketable (debt, equity, or other) securities whose use is restricted in whole or in part, generally by contractual agreements or regulatory requirements. For use in an unclassified balance sheet.
representativeQueries: What are the total restricted investments we have?

tables.title: Settlement Liabilities, Current — SEC EDGAR

How much does the airline owe for money transfers and payment services?

tables.title: Temporary Equity, Maturity, Year Four — SEC EDGAR
